title: Mixed Event — Insatiable Pale Color — Episode1 An Insatiable Heart

meta.Event Outline: While Kanade and the others embrace Nightcord at 25:00's rising popularity, Ena's illustration account remains stagnant. Ena then sets her sights on an art competition...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <K, I finished writing the lyrics for our new song.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You're hitting a new theme with this one! Yuki is showing us a different side of her personality.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <How can you write something this good without putting any thought into it?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Intuition, I guess? It must take a lot of talent. That's what I thought when I heard your OWN songs too.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That reminds me! Marionette has got so many views now, you wouldn't believe it!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <We even got comments from famous artists. It's attracting a lot of attention!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You weren't kidding. We never had this many comments before!>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <The illustrations were also very good this time.>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <The images changing to match the lyrics during the chorus really makes you feel a complex range of emotions.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Oh...! That's from the same person who always comments on my illustrations.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (They can tell what I was trying to do...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Looks like we're finally garnering some fame for ourselves!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Well, not that fame matters to K or Yuki....>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It makes me happy to know that our songs are reaching so many people out there...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Maybe they'll even make a difference in someone's life.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hehe. I guess that part of you will never change, K.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But having that kind of impact would be nice.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Can our songs really achieve that? I haven't really been going for anything like that at all.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <We know, Enanan. All you care about is getting lots of likes♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, don't make me sound so superficial.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I hit the nail on the head, didn't I?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <O-Of course I want my artwork to be seen by as many people as possible...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But I'm not drawing just for likes. I enjoy making illustrations, simple as that.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <In other words, it's your passion. That's pretty cool!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <To be fair, I'm not surprised we hit the jackpot with this song. The video I made for it was one of my best works yet!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And your artwork was a cut above your usual stuff too, Enanan♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, what do you mean by my usual stuff?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I also really liked your artwork. The imagery reflected the feel of the song and meshed well with the lyrics.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You value her compliments more than mine? No fair.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Moving on, let's finish up our new song. We only have a little bit to go before it's ready to upload.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
K really liked my art...
Genuinely...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe, that makes me even more motivated.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll probably have to pull an all-nighter again, which means I'll need snacks.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Perfect timing. Can you grab me a custard pudding from the refrigerator?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Grab me a juice too. Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm busy, you know. Go get them yourself.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What's gotten into him? It was just a small favor, sheesh.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Fine. Guess I have to go downstairs myself.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Why is he still awake this late...?!)

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: You don't have talent. You'll never become an artist.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (N25's songs have been getting more views, and people are even praising my illustrations in the comments!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (My illustration account isn't getting more followers...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The pictures I uploaded are getting hardly any likes, let alone comments...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I guess that makes sense. I haven't mentioned in the account's profile that I do illustrations for N25.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I could probably get more followers if I dropped our group name but...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I want my art to be judged purely for what it is.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I want to be known as an artist in my own right, not just as N25's illustrator!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, where did I put that plushie I got from Akito's friend the other day...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I bet it'll look cute in a photo.
I think I'll use it for today's post.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I wish you'd post more often... I want to see this every day... Love!...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: A photo that takes me less than five minutes to take gets an immediate response...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I guess this means I really don't...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (As long as I do, someone will eventually appreciate my art...)
